card.name: Words before tracer and lab-method terms
card.fires_on: Small words (of, by, used, up) or list gaps just before a radiolabel, isotope, or lab-method term in study and procedure descriptions. Also fires on spots inside numbers or strain names, such as a space after a list of time points.

modes.label: Linking word before method
modes.description: A preposition or verb such as of, by, or used that comes right before a tracer, assay, or injection term.
